focus.missing_fx: Some lines have no exchange rate yet, so they are missing from the total. Add the rate under Display and rates. The original amount is still stored.

currency.title: Display and rates
currency.hint: The display currency only changes the totals. Balances stay in their own currency. Write each rate as how many yuan one unit is worth. Yuan itself needs no rate.

columns.liabilitiesEmpty: No liabilities. Leave this empty if you owe nothing.

principles.title: How to read this
principles.item1: Net worth is assets minus liabilities. Keep a savings balance and a card balance on separate lines.
principles.item2: Value A-shares in yuan and Hong Kong shares in Hong Kong dollars. Yen and won stay in those currencies. Gold uses the currency you price it in.
principles.item3: The housing fund and medical-insurance balance count in total assets, not in money you can spend. Emergency cash is bank deposits plus WeChat and Alipay.
principles.item4: Spending is fixed (housing, sport, insurance), daily (food, commute, shopping), an emergency reserve, and other. The reserve is not part of the monthly running cost.
principles.item5: Every balance change needs a reason and a time. The history stays on that account, in the currency it was saved in.
